citation: Jiu's Sharing Station, "China Train Rules & Fees Cheat Sheet", checked 2026-11-05, https://jiunotes.top/china-train-rules-fees-cheatsheet
note: Every entry carries the official Chinese source that states it and the date it was last checked. Rules change without announcement; compare checked_on against your travel date.

facts.claim_en: China train tickets go on sale 15 days in advance (including the day of sale)
facts.claim_zh: 中国火车票预售期为15天（含当天）

source.name: 新华网（转中国铁路官方）

facts.claim_en: Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong cross-border high-speed rail tickets: 15-day advance sale (incl. sale day)
facts.claim_zh: 广深港跨境高铁车票预售期为15天（含当天）

facts.claim_en: Official purchase channels: 12306 website/App is the ONLY official channel; also station windows, ticket machines, phone booking and authorized agents
facts.claim_zh: 购票渠道：12306网站（含铁路12306移动端）是唯一官方网站；另有车站窗口、自动售票机、订票电话和代售点

facts.claim_en: Each ticket can be changed ONCE (including changing the destination station) when capacity allows
facts.claim_zh: 每张车票在有运输能力的前提下可办理1次改签（含变更到站）

facts.claim_en: Changing a ticket carries no percentage fee. You simply pay the fare difference if the new ticket costs more, or get the difference back if it costs less. The only fee that can arise is the refund fee, and only if you later cancel instead of travelling.
facts.claim_zh: 改签不收百分比手续费：新车票更贵的补差额，更便宜的退还差额。唯一可能产生的费用是退票费，而且只有在你后来选择退票、而不是乘车时才会收。

source.name: 中国铁路12306官网（铁路旅客购票须知）

facts.claim_en: Children under 6 ride free (one per adult, no seat); ages 6-13 get child discount fare; ages 14+ pay full fare
facts.claim_zh: 未满6周岁免费乘车（每名成人限1名不占席）；6-13周岁购儿童优惠票；年满14周岁购全价票

facts.claim_en: Child discount fare: 50% of full fare on conventional trains and EMU 2nd/1st class; 70% on EMU sleeper
facts.claim_zh: 儿童优惠票：普速列车及动车二等/一等座按全价50%计；动车卧铺按全价70%计
facts.figure: 50% of full fare (70% for EMU sleeper)

facts.claim_en: Cross-border ticket ID types: Chinese resident ID, Mainland Travel Permit / residence permits for HK/Macao/Taiwan residents, foreign permanent residence ID, valid passports, temporary ID
facts.claim_zh: 跨境购票可用证件：居民身份证、港澳台居民居住证、港澳居民来往内地通行证、台湾居民来往大陆通行证、外国人永久居留身份证、有效护照及临时身份证明

facts.claim_en: The 12306 English website accepts ONLY valid foreign passports for ticket purchase
facts.claim_zh: 12306英文网站仅接受有效外国护照购票

facts.claim_en: Free checked/hand luggage weight: 20 kg per adult, 10 kg per child, 35 kg for diplomatic personnel
facts.claim_zh: 免费携带品重量：其他旅客20千克、儿童10千克、外交人员35千克

facts.claim_en: Carry-on size: sum of length+width+height up to 160 cm on conventional trains, 130 cm on EMU; rod-shaped items up to 200 cm; each piece up to 20 kg
facts.claim_zh: 携带品尺寸：长宽高之和不超过160厘米（动车组130厘米），杆状物品不超过200厘米，每件重量不超过20千克

facts.claim_en: Restricted carry-on: cigarettes up to 50 cartons; liquor with 24%-70% alcohol up to 3000 ml; live animals prohibited (guide dogs and sealed aquatic food excepted)
facts.claim_zh: 限量携带品：香烟最多50条；酒精含量24%-70%的白酒不超过3000毫升；活动物禁带（导盲犬和封闭包装水产除外）

facts.claim_en: Beijing-Shanghai HSR published (list) fares rose 20% from 26 May 2026 for 300-350 km/h and 200-250 km/h EMU trains; execution fares capped by published fare with variable discounts
facts.claim_zh: 京沪高铁公布票价自2026年5月26日起上浮20%（时速300~350公里及200~250公里及以下动车组）；执行票价以公布票价为上限、按不同幅度折扣浮动

source.name: 京沪高速铁路股份有限公司（上交所公告）

facts.claim_en: Beijing-Shanghai HSR full-route 2nd class published-fare cap about 820 CNY (from 26 May 2026); actual execution fares roughly 576-672 CNY depending on train and time
facts.claim_zh: 京沪高铁全程二等座公布票价上限约820元（2026年5月26日起）；实际执行票价约576~672元（因车次、时段不同浮动）

source.name: 中国新闻周刊（京沪高铁公司公告核实）

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: FREE when cancelling 8+ days before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前8天以上退票不收取退票费

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 5% when cancelling 48 hours to 8 days before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前48小时至8天退票按票面价格5%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 10% when cancelling 24-48 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前24小时至48小时退票按票面价格10%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee: 20% when cancelling less than 24 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 退票费：开车前不足24小时退票按票面价格20%计

facts.claim_en: Refund fee rounded to nearest 0.5 yuan, minimum 2 yuan (less than 2 yuan charged at ticket price)
facts.claim_zh: 退票费以5角为单位计算，最低按2元计收（票价不足2元时按票价计收）

facts.claim_en: Refund timing: cancel before departure online; tickets changed after departure and points-exchange tickets are NOT refundable; cash purchases refunded at station window within 180 days after online cancellation
facts.claim_zh: 退票时限：开车前可网上退票；开车后改签的车票和积分兑换车票不办理退票；现金购票线上退票后180日内到车站窗口退款

facts.claim_en: Students get 4 discounted one-way trips per academic year (Oct 1 - Sep 30); 50% conventional hard seat, 75% EMU 2nd class
facts.claim_zh: 学生优惠票：每学年（10月1日至次年9月30日）可购4次单程；普速硬座50%、动车二等座75%

facts.claim_en: Waitlist (候补) purchase: each user can submit 2 waitlist orders, each with 2 adjacent dates and up to 5 train/class combos, up to 9 passengers per order; deadline no later than 2 hours before departure
facts.claim_zh: 候补购票：每位用户可提交2个候补订单，每个订单含2个相邻日期、5个车次席别组合，最多9名乘车人；截止时间不晚于开车前2小时

facts.claim_en: The National Railway Administration put China's high-speed operating mileage at 48,000 km at the end of 2024, more than 70% of the world total.
Perfume, toilet water, sprays and gels - flammable non-aerosol daily-use containers - are limited to containers of no more than 100 ml each, one container per type.
facts.claim_zh: 香水、花露水、喷雾、凝胶等含易燃成分的非自喷压力容器日用品，单体容器容积不超过100毫升，每种限带1件。

facts.claim_en: Nail polish and nail-polish remover are limited to a cumulative 50 ml.
facts.claim_zh: 指甲油、去光剂累计不超过50毫升。

facts.claim_en: Aerosol cans - cold-wave liquid, hair dye, mousse, hairspray, insecticide, air freshener - are limited to 150 ml per can, one per type, cumulative no more than 600 ml.
facts.claim_zh: 冷烫精、染发剂、摩丝、发胶、杀虫剂、空气清新剂等自喷压力容器，单体容器容积不超过150毫升，每种限带1件，累计不超过600毫升。

facts.claim_en: Safety matches are limited to 2 small boxes and ordinary lighters to 2 units.
facts.claim_zh: 安全火柴不超过2小盒，普通打火机不超过2个。

facts.claim_en: Clearly labelled power banks and lithium batteries are limited to a single rated energy of no more than 100 Wh; electric wheelchairs containing lithium batteries are excepted.
facts.claim_zh: 标志清晰的充电宝、锂电池，单块额定能量不超过100Wh，含有锂电池的电动轮椅除外。

facts.claim_en: Daily-use cutting tools with a blade longer than 60 mm - kitchen knives, fruit knives, scissors, craft knives - may not be carried on board but may be checked as baggage.
facts.claim_zh: 锐器：菜刀、水果刀、剪刀、美工刀、雕刻刀、裁纸刀等日用刀具（刀刃长度超过60毫米），禁止随身携带但可以托运。

facts.claim_en: The railway prohibited-and-restricted items catalogue for passengers took effect on 1 July 2022, replacing the 2015 list.
facts.claim_zh: 本公告自2022年7月1日起施行，原《国家铁路局 公安部关于发布铁路〈禁止携带物品目录〉的公告》（国铁运输监〔2015〕3号）同时废止。

facts.claim_en: China Railway 12306 permits one change per ticket with no percentage fee: more than 48 hours before departure you may switch to any train in the 15-day sale window, while inside 48 hours only a train on the same travel date or earlier, under the 2023 official change rules ( source ).
